review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review; independent code review pending HQ)
review.notes: Reviewed against approved DESIGN P0 and VALIDATION 2,7-12,16-18,21-24,26-27,31-32. All fixtures use explicit temporary Store directories; process/service calls replaced with bounded synthetic adapters. No real HQ state, user authorization, message delivery, deployment or historical correction. Tests assert persisted observable state/receipts and failures, not mirrored branches. Full goal/attempt model and device acceptance excluded.

cases.description: Late/duplicate reports cannot reopen completed matters or erase the current question; observation saved exactly once.

cases.action: Exercise public Store and CLI adapter APIs including duplicate/conflicting writes, late inputs, restart and lease turnover.
cases.expected: Late/duplicate reports cannot reopen completed matters or erase the current question; observation saved exactly once.
